profileObservation.fieldScan: After the 21500 common EntityType/attribute-Pointer/entity-ID prefix and six geometry pointer fields, the rooted projection exposes face sense followed by sidedness; containment is only present when double-sided is true.
profileObservation.evidenceLimit: Values are parsed from one source by libdxfrw through the selected rooted view. They do not independently prove ACIS 21500 field semantics, outward orientation, surface-normal meaning, or B-rep validity.

generatedControl.origin: The ACIS 21500 rooted body SAB is generated in memory by tests/graph_preservation_tests.cpp.
generatedControl.fields: The synthetic face stores six pointer fields, then BoolFalse sense, BoolTrue double-sided, and BoolTrue containment. The control verifies these values are projected from the bounded 21500-prefixed record view.

sourceProbe.result: PASS: six projected faces; sense states [forward, reversed, reversed, reversed, reversed, reversed]; all single-sided; no containment fields present.
sourceProbe.independence: Probe uses the current libdxfrw implementation and is not independent semantic evidence.
